xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Pursuant to the search action conducted on the Company by the Income-tax authorities in December 2023, assessment/ re-assessment orders under section 143(3) read with section 147 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 for AY 2014-15 to AY 2022-23 were passed during 4th quarter of FY2024-25 resulting into aggregate tax demand of INR 560.54 million, along with interest amounting to INR 216.15 million. Further, the same was intimated to the Stock Exchanges on 30-Jan-25.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
